It reads players (one row by steam_id, of which only id and active_title_id are used; the row is never serialized), player_items joined to shop_items (sku), shop_items (sku, id) and title_ladder_progress (line, games, tier), and answers a fixed projection built from those values and the in-module LADDERS catalogue. Its first statement is SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY (one snapshot per request), and each rung's owned also asks main._auto_owned(steam_id, sku), a set test on the path parameter that sends no query. It reads no matches table and no Match ORM row, so no W1 seat column can reach its output.
